name: agent-workflows
description: Evidence-based code review, independent test authors, a verify gate for substantial tasks, and Go-focused engineering skills for Claude Code.

enforce_verify.title: Gate git commit and push on cw task verify
enforce_verify.description: When an open substantial cw task record exists for this repository, block commit and push until cw task verify has passed on the current source.

small_task_prompt.title: Ask before publishing a large unrecorded change
small_task_prompt.description: With no open cw task record for the repository, ask before a commit or push whose change has two of: more than 300 changed lines, more than one top-level directory, code changed without tests.

session_doctor.title: Run cw doctor at session start
session_doctor.description: Inject a cached cw doctor --summary for the project at session start.
